author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
The first Jurassic Park is filled with iconic moments, with many featuring Steven Spielberg's signature camera moves. One especially memorable moment opens the film: a push in on an excavated piece of amber with mosquito embedded inside. That original prop--complete with mosquito--is even more beautiful in person!

Learn more about this prop and the upcoming Propstore EMLA auction: https://propstoreauction.com/auctions/info/id/525
See all the props and costumes in this auction in the catalog: https://propstoreauction.com/auctions/catalog/id/525

Shot by Joey Fameli and edited by Norman Chan
Music by Jinglepunks
